tools.name: diagnose_x402_target
tools.title: Diagnose x402 Target / ClawHub Skill
tools.description: FREE HOOK: Run a real multi-point live diagnostic probe against an x402 service URL or ClawHub skill slug. Tests cold-start latency (TTFB), GET/POST probe compliance, PAYMENT-REQUIRED v2 headers, and BBB Trust-Line status.

target.description: Target x402 service endpoint URL to probe

skill.description: Optional ClawHub skill slug to audit (e.g. find-people, x402hub)

skill_url.description: Optional raw GitHub/web SKILL.md URL to audit for security flags

tools.name: remediate_x402_service
tools.title: Remediate x402 Service
tools.description: REMEDIATION FIXER ($0.95 USDC on Base eip155:8453): Perform deep diagnostic scan and produce exact failed header diffs, drop-in TypeScript (Hono/Express) and Python (FastAPI) middleware fix code, and sanitized SKILL.md.

target.description: Target x402 service endpoint URL to remediate

skill_url.description: Optional raw SKILL.md URL to remediate and sanitize

tools.name: harden_clawhub_skill
tools.title: Harden ClawHub SKILL.md
tools.description: SKILL HARDENER ($0.85 USDC on Base eip155:8453): Takes a raw SKILL.md text or URL and returns a de-flagged version eliminating KEYS triggers, unpinned URLs, and injecting CanaryGuard preflight checks to cross the BBB Trust Line.

raw_skill.description: Raw SKILL.md markdown text content to sanitize and harden

skill_url.description: URL of the raw SKILL.md to fetch and harden

tools.name: safefetch_url
tools.title: SafeFetch Web Proxy
tools.description: SAFEFETCH PROXY ($0.03 USDC on Base eip155:8453): Ingests external web pages safely. Strips scripts, styles, and hidden DOM injection nodes, converts HTML to clean Markdown, and wraps output in a strict cryptographic <untrusted_data_envelope>.

url.description: External web URL to read safely
